title: Replace current app with a mobile-friendly offline-capable video editing PWA

requirements.text: Replace the current primary app experience (Teen Patti game UI) with a mobile-first video editing web app that runs entirely on-device (no uploads) and can be kept/used on the user’s personal phone.

quotes: Hello assalamu alaikum aap mujhe ek aisi website taiyar karke de sakte ho Jo video edit wali ho vah maine apne personal phone mein rakhne hain

acceptanceCriteria: Launching the app shows a video editor home screen (not the Teen Patti game)
The app supports selecting a video file from the device and previews it in-app
All processing is local in the browser (no network requests are required to edit a video)
All user-facing text in the new video editor UI is in English

requirements.text: Implement a basic, phone-friendly video editing workflow with at least: import video, trim start/end, mute/unmute audio, and export/save the edited video as a downloadable file.

quotes: ek aisi website ... Jo video edit wali ho

acceptanceCriteria: User can pick a local video file and see duration + a preview
User can set trim start and trim end (with validation: start < end, within duration)
User can toggle audio mute for the exported result
User can export and receive a downloadable edited video file (or a clearly labeled export result)
If export fails (unsupported browser/device), the app shows an English error message and a retry action

requirements.text: Add a clear in-app Help/About dialog for the video editor that explains: the editor works on this device, videos are not uploaded by the app, and how to install the app to the home screen.

quotes: ... apne personal phone mein rakhne hain

acceptanceCriteria: Help/About content is updated to video-editor context (no Teen Patti/game/online-only text)
Help/About states in English that the app edits locally on the device and does not upload videos
Help/About includes short, correct PWA install instructions (English)

requirements.text: Update app chrome and metadata to match the new video editor product: header title, favicon/app icons, index.html meta title/description, and the PWA manifest name/short_name/description/categories.

quotes: website ... Jo video edit wali ho

acceptanceCriteria: Header title is updated to an English name for the video editor (no 'Teen Patti')
frontend/index.html <title> and description reflect the video editor
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest reflects the video editor name/description and uses the new icon files
The installed PWA name on Android matches the updated manifest

requirements.text: Adjust the service worker and offline behavior so the video editor app shell is available offline after first load, enabling the user to open the installed app and edit local videos without an internet connection.

quotes: ... apne personal phone mein rakhne hain

acceptanceCriteria: After visiting once, the PWA can be opened while offline and shows the editor UI (not only offline.html)
Offline editing works for local videos without requiring network connectivity
If a required asset is missing in offline mode, the app shows a clear English message and a retry option when online

requirements.text: Apply a coherent, non-blue/purple default visual theme suitable for a clean ‘mobile video editor’ app (typography, spacing, surfaces, button hierarchy) and use it consistently across the editor screen and dialogs.
acceptanceCriteria: Primary/secondary buttons and dialog surfaces look consistent and app-like on mobile
No default blue/purple-dominant palette is introduced unless already present; keep styling cohesive and modern
The layout is mobile-first with no horizontal scrolling on common phone sizes

constraints: Frontend immutable paths must not be edited: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui
Do not add any real-money payments, ads integrations, or third-party authentication beyond what already exists
Keep backend as single-actor Motoko; only change backend if strictly necessary (video editing should be frontend-only)
nonGoals: Building a server-side video processing pipeline or uploading/storing user videos on the backend
Adding real-money monetization (subscriptions, in-app purchases, ads)
Multi-user accounts, sharing edited videos via in-app social features, or cloud syncing

required: Minimal, modern video editor app icon (video-editor-icon.dim_256x256.png)
Minimal, modern video editor app icon (maskable) (video-editor-icon-maskable.dim_256x256.png)
Minimal, modern video editor app icon (video-editor-icon.dim_192x192.png)
